basics.name: Chris Lam
basics.label: Product Design Engineer for AI-native products
basics.summary: Product design engineer with 14 years shipping healthcare, creative, developer, and consumer software. Built my career in product design, including early roles at Clover Health, GoodRx, Pathstream, and StartPlaying, then deliberately deepened into production engineering. Today I own products end to end: research, interaction design, design systems, React/TypeScript/Python implementation, agent architecture, evals, and production verification. Recent work includes a voice-AI system with deterministic safety controls and collaborative game-development tooling with a custom real-time engine. Seeking senior or lead IC design-engineering roles on AI-native teams.

work.name: y30
work.summary: Voice AI for older adults and their care teams.
highlights: Built an FSM safety engine where crisis paths are deterministic code, not prompt instructions, a hard state the model cannot override.
Architected a streaming speech-to-text to LLM to text-to-speech pipeline (multi-provider, deep fallback) fronted by a deterministic state machine.
Scoped the language model to phrasing and warmth while conversation flow runs as a deterministic state machine; about half of routing decisions resolve with no model call.
Built the first version in TypeScript, then deliberately rewrote it in Python to fit the real-time voice framework, carrying the state-machine architecture and safety model across the rewrite.
Designed elder-first voice UX: no app, no screen, no login, just a phone call.
1,389 commits, 127 test files.

work.name: PlaySesh
work.summary: Collaborative game development tools for indie developers, built inside Discord.
highlights: Shipped 0 to 1 alone in Vanilla JS, Express, and Supabase before recruiting co-founders; primary engineer who authored 1,147 of the project's 1,790 commits, with 291 passing tests and zero ad spend.

Authored the core real-time engine: a custom operation-based sync protocol on Cloudflare Durable Objects, including authoritative ordering and WebSocket reconnection logic, after moving off an off-the-shelf canvas library.
Grew organically to 6,220 authorized Discord accounts and 138 server installs, peaking at 1,043 monthly active users (January 2026). Discord counts as of August 1, 2026.
Pivoted from social gaming to game dev tooling based on user behavior signal.

work.name: CureWise
work.summary: Oncology AI platform. Shipped multi-agent features in Next.js and TypeScript on a Firebase/Fasten Health stack.

work.name: Blue Startups
work.summary: Conducted design and product audits for 10 early-stage startups in cohort 16. Advised on product strategy, MVP scope, and design-to-engineering handoffs.

work.name: Modus Create
work.summary: Shipped dark mode for JIRA and Confluence Cloud (500K+ enterprise users). Owned design, engineering implementation, and internal dev documentation. Contributed to the CI/CD pipeline with Docker Compose.

work.name: StartPlaying
work.summary: First designer at a YC W20, a16z-backed seed-stage TTRPG marketplace. Redesigned the payment experience with Stripe for 100% on-time payouts; shipped a game master onboarding flow.

work.name: doc.ai (acquired by Sharecare)
work.summary: Rescue hire during the doc.ai acquisition; Sharecare later went public (NASDAQ: SHCR, 2021). Redesigned a legacy clinical-studies product through user testing and competitive research.

work.name: Pathstream
work.summary: First design hire at a career-development and LMS platform. Shipped accessibility improvements, engagement features, and design-system foundations.

work.name: Iodine (acquired by GoodRx)
work.summary: First full-time designer, pre-IPO; GoodRx later IPO'd (NASDAQ: GDRX). Iodine acquired by GoodRx (2017).
highlights: Redesigned the coupon redemption flow; conversion rate 2% to 5%.
Contributed to GoodRx Research data visualizations referenced in the New York Times and on Good Morning America / ABC News.
Iodine.com won the Webby for Best Health Website (2018). I was the product's designer.
Built 50-state prescription-price fact sheets with GoodRx co-CEO Doug Hirsch, used in advocacy around S.2554 and S.2553 on drug price transparency.

work.name: Clover Health
work.summary: 2nd designer, pre-IPO; Clover Health later IPO'd (NYSE: CLOV).
highlights: Redesigned the nurse practitioner home-visit iPad web app end to end through contextual shadowing. ~7 to 8x lift in visit-related revenue; saved ~2 hours per nurse per day.
Led cross-functional alignment across design, engineering, product, data science, and medical.

work.name: TaskRabbit
work.summary: Worked on the 2014 rebrand; TaskRabbit later acquired by IKEA (2017).
highlights: Owned the Tasker experience and helped across the 2014 rebrand with the PMs.
Tasker NPS recovered from about -5 in mid-2014 to the mid-50s; Client NPS to the high-40s.

work.name: Amazon
highlights: Prototyped the buy-and-gift Prime flow that contributed to 1M+ new subscribers.
Partnered with Samsung on the Amazon Prime Music app for the Samsung Shape wireless speaker.
